# Pull request

## Outcome

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and rationale.

Closes #ISSUE

## Validation

Record focused tests and applicable repository, documentation, static-analysis, and runtime evidence.
Identify unavailable checks honestly; canonical CI owns the ordinary complete Python suite.

## Delivery evidence

- [ ] Followed [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and its applicable conditional routes.
- [ ] Linked issues have exactly one type label; documentation and synchronized next patch are included.
- [ ] Followed [PR review and delivery](../docs/contribute/pr-workflow.md), including consolidated review,
  current-head checks and feedback, and explicit maintainer holds.
- [ ] If UI changed, recorded the [UI classification and reused reference](../docs/contribute/ui-design-guide.md),
  required approval, and desktop/narrow evidence.
- [ ] If infrastructure was created, recorded ownership inventory and
  [release/cleanup handoff](../docs/contribute/completed-task-cleanup.md).

Use [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for private remediation; never put advisory identifiers or sensitive findings here.
